# layer1: cell-number benchmark cell-phase inference + ECDF + scatter plots + RAM

rm(list = ls()); gc()

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(devtools)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(profmem)
})

# Step 0. Load package

devtools::load_all("/Users/zhangqian/Desktop/scRhythmBayes")

# Step 1. Helpers

wrap24 <- function(x) {
  ((x %% 24) + 24) %% 24
}

circ_abs_err_h <- function(pred_h, true_h) {
  diff_h <- abs((pred_h - true_h) %% 24)
  pmin(diff_h, 24 - diff_h)
}

calc_phase_metrics <- function(true_h, pred_h) {
  err_h <- circ_abs_err_h(pred_h = pred_h, true_h = true_h)
  err_h <- sort(err_h)
  hrsoff <- c(0, err_h, 12)

  frac_wrong <- sapply(hrsoff, function(hrtol) {
    100 * sum(err_h > hrtol) / length(err_h)
  })

  pct_correct <- 100 - frac_wrong
  norm_pct_correct <- pct_correct / 100
  norm_hrsoff <- hrsoff / 12
  auc <- sum(norm_pct_correct[-length(norm_pct_correct)] * diff(norm_hrsoff))
  medae <- median(err_h)

  list(
    AUC = auc,
    MedAE = medae,
    n_cell = length(err_h),
    threshold_h = hrsoff,
    pct_correct = pct_correct,
    err_h = err_h
  )
}

make_grid_cdf <- function(true_h, pred_h, threshold_grid) {
  err_h <- circ_abs_err_h(pred_h = pred_h, true_h = true_h)

  tibble(
    threshold_h = threshold_grid,
    pct_correct = sapply(threshold_grid, function(hrtol) {
      100 * sum(err_h <= hrtol) / length(err_h)
    })
  )
}

summarise_profmem <- function(pm, target_n_cell, rep_id, step_name, elapsed_min) {
  pm_df <- as.data.frame(pm)
  alloc <- pm_df$bytes[is.finite(pm_df$bytes)]

  tibble(
    step = step_name,
    target_n_cell = target_n_cell,
    repeat_id = rep_id,
    elapsed_min = elapsed_min,
    n_alloc = length(alloc),
    total_alloc_mb = sum(alloc, na.rm = TRUE) / 1024^2,
    max_single_alloc_mb = max(alloc, na.rm = TRUE) / 1024^2
  )
}

remove_text_layers <- function(p) {
  keep_layer <- vapply(
    p$layers,
    function(x) {
      !inherits(x$geom, "GeomText") &&
        !inherits(x$geom, "GeomLabel") &&
        !inherits(x$geom, "GeomTextRepel") &&
        !inherits(x$geom, "GeomLabelRepel")
    },
    logical(1)
  )

  p$layers <- p$layers[keep_layer]
  p
}

save_phase_scatter <- function(res_phase, metadata, title_text, point_col, out_pdf, out_tiff) {
  p_phase <- plot_phase_scatter(
    res_phase = res_phase,
    metadata = metadata,
    truth_by = "ZT_true",
    pred_by = "ZT_pred",
    point_col = point_col
  )

  p_phase$plot <- remove_text_layers(p_phase$plot)

  p_phase$plot <- p_phase$plot +
    ggtitle(title_text) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 9,
        family = "serif"
      )
    )

  pdf(file = out_pdf, width = 3.2, height = 3.2)
  print(p_phase$plot)
  dev.off()

  tiff(
    filename = out_tiff,
    width = 3.2,
    height = 3.2,
    units = "in",
    res = 300,
    compression = "lzw"
  )
  print(p_phase$plot)
  dev.off()

  invisible(p_phase)
}

# Step 2. IO

out_dir <- "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/benchmark_cell_number_4000g_6tp"

obj_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "sim_objects")
phase_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "res_phase")
plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots_cell_phase")
index_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "index")
ram_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "ram_profile")

timepoint_ref_dir <- "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/benchmark_timepoint_number_4000g_20000c"
timepoint_ref_obj <- file.path(timepoint_ref_dir, "sim_objects", "simulate_data_timepoint6_4000g_20000c.rds")
timepoint_ref_phase <- file.path(timepoint_ref_dir, "res_phase", "res_phase_timepoint6_rep1.rds")

unlink(phase_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
unlink(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
unlink(ram_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)

dir.create(phase_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(index_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(ram_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

run_cell_number_vec <- c(10500, 6000, 3000, 1500, 600)
cell_number_vec <- c(20000, 10500, 6000, 3000, 1500, 600)

n_repeat <- 1
ZT_points <- c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20)

cell_number_cols <- c(
  "20000" = "#A8C7E6",
  "10500" = "#57ADDE",
  "6000"  = "#17441e",
  "3000"  = "#3a621f",
  "1500"  = "#357090",
  "600"   = "#2F6F73"
)

cell_number_label <- c(
  "20000" = "20,000 cells",
  "10500" = "10,500 cells",
  "6000"  = "6,000 cells",
  "3000"  = "3,000 cells",
  "1500"  = "1,500 cells",
  "600"   = "600 cells"
)

stopifnot(file.exists(timepoint_ref_obj), file.exists(timepoint_ref_phase))

# Step 3. Run cell-phase inference for cell-number benchmark only

phase_record_all <- list()
ram_record_all <- list()
run_id <- 1

for (target_n_cell in run_cell_number_vec) {
  for (rep_id in seq_len(n_repeat)) {
    message("============================================================")
    message("Running cell-phase inference")
    message("target_n_cell = ", target_n_cell, " | repeat = ", rep_id)

    obj_file <- file.path(
      obj_dir,
      paste0("simulate_data_cell", target_n_cell, "_4000g_6tp.rds")
    )

    phase_file <- file.path(
      phase_dir,
      paste0("res_phase_cell", target_n_cell, "_rep", rep_id, ".rds")
    )

    obj_sim <- readRDS(obj_file)
    DefaultAssay(obj_sim) <- "RNA"

    count <- Seurat::GetAssayData(
      obj_sim,
      assay = "RNA",
      slot = "counts"
    )

    metadata <- obj_sim@meta.data %>%
      as.data.frame()
    metadata$cell <- rownames(metadata)

    stopifnot(
      identical(colnames(count), metadata$cell),
      all(c("ZT_sym", "ZT_true", "theta_true", "theta_obs", "celltype", "condition", "group") %in% colnames(metadata))
    )

    zt_observed <- sort(unique(as.numeric(metadata$ZT_sym)))

    message("Observed ZT points: ", paste(zt_observed, collapse = ", "))
    message("Expected ZT points: ", paste(ZT_points, collapse = ", "))
    stopifnot(identical(zt_observed, ZT_points))

    lib_size <- Matrix::colSums(count)
    keep_cell <- is.finite(lib_size) &
      lib_size > 0 &
      is.finite(as.numeric(metadata$ZT_sym)) &
      is.finite(as.numeric(metadata$ZT_true)) &
      !is.na(metadata$celltype)

    message("Total cells before QC: ", ncol(count))
    message("Cells removed before infer_cell_phase: ", sum(!keep_cell))

    count <- count[, keep_cell, drop = FALSE]
    metadata <- metadata[keep_cell, , drop = FALSE]
    metadata$cell <- rownames(metadata)

    stopifnot(
      identical(colnames(count), metadata$cell),
      all(Matrix::colSums(count) > 0),
      length(unique(metadata$celltype)) == 1,
      all(unique(metadata$celltype) == "Celltype1"),
      length(unique(metadata$condition)) == 2,
      all(sort(unique(as.character(metadata$condition))) == c("cond_1", "cond_2"))
    )

    message("Condition x ZT table:")
    print(table(metadata$condition, metadata$ZT_sym))
    message("Celltype table:")
    print(table(metadata$celltype))

    metadata$ZT_fit <- as.numeric(metadata$ZT_sym)
    zt_fit_note <- "ZT_fit equals ZT_sym."

    t_start <- proc.time()

    pm <- profmem({
      res_phase <- infer_cell_phase(
        count = count,
        metadata = metadata,
        ZT_by = "ZT_fit",
        strata_by = "celltype",
        Species = "mouse",
        n_grid = 60,
        n_iter_outer = 5,
        n_iter_seed = 3,
        Kappa = 5,
        p_mix = 0.85,
        Min_n = 50,
        setseed = 2026 + rep_id,
        Verbose = TRUE
      )
    })

    elapsed_min <- as.numeric((proc.time() - t_start)["elapsed"]) / 60

    ram_record_all[[run_id]] <- summarise_profmem(
      pm = pm,
      target_n_cell = target_n_cell,
      rep_id = rep_id,
      step_name = "infer_cell_phase",
      elapsed_min = elapsed_min
    )

    write_csv(
      bind_rows(ram_record_all),
      file.path(ram_dir, "cell_number_layer1_profmem_summary.csv")
    )

    res_phase <- res_phase %>%
      mutate(
        target_n_cell = target_n_cell,
        actual_n_cell = ncol(count),
        repeat_id = rep_id,
        benchmark = "cell_number",
        n_timepoint = length(ZT_points),
        ZT_design = paste(ZT_points, collapse = ","),
        ZT_fit_note = zt_fit_note
      )

    saveRDS(res_phase, phase_file)

    phase_record_all[[run_id]] <- tibble(
      target_n_cell = target_n_cell,
      actual_n_cell = ncol(count),
      repeat_id = rep_id,
      ZT_points = paste(ZT_points, collapse = ","),
      object_file = obj_file,
      res_phase_file = phase_file,
      source = "cell_number_new",
      file_exists = file.exists(phase_file),
      elapsed_min = elapsed_min,
      status = "finished_new",
      error_message = NA_character_
    )

    write_csv(
      bind_rows(phase_record_all),
      file.path(index_dir, "cell_number_res_phase_file_index_partial.csv")
    )

    message("Saved res_phase: ", phase_file)
    message("Elapsed time: ", round(elapsed_min, 2), " min")
    message("Median Rbar: ", round(median(res_phase$Rbar, na.rm = TRUE), 4))
    message("Median r_cell: ", round(median(res_phase$r_cell, na.rm = TRUE), 4))

    run_id <- run_id + 1
    rm(obj_sim, count, metadata, res_phase, lib_size, keep_cell, pm)
    gc()
  }
}

# Step 4. Add existing 20,000-cell reference from time-point benchmark

obj_ref <- readRDS(timepoint_ref_obj)
metadata_ref <- obj_ref@meta.data %>%
  as.data.frame()
metadata_ref$cell <- rownames(metadata_ref)

# Step 5. Evaluate cell-phase accuracy

phase_index_success <- phase_index %>%
  filter(status %in% c("finished_new", "finished_reference"), file_exists)

stopifnot(nrow(phase_index_success) == length(cell_number_vec) * n_repeat)

auc_all <- list()
cdf_all <- list()
eval_all <- list()
eval_id <- 1

for (i in seq_len(nrow(phase_index_success))) {
  target_n_cell <- phase_index_success$target_n_cell[i]
  rep_id <- phase_index_success$repeat_id[i]

  message("============================================================")
  message("Evaluating target_n_cell = ", target_n_cell, " | repeat = ", rep_id)

  obj_sim <- readRDS(phase_index_success$object_file[i])

  metadata <- obj_sim@meta.data %>%
    as.data.frame()
  metadata$cell <- rownames(metadata)

  res_phase <- readRDS(phase_index_success$res_phase_file[i])

  res_eval <- res_phase %>%
    mutate(cell = as.character(cell)) %>%
    left_join(
      metadata %>%
        select(cell, ZT_true, theta_true, theta_obs, ZT_sym, celltype, condition, group),
      by = "cell"
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(ZT_true), is.finite(ZT_pred))

  m_i <- calc_phase_metrics(
    true_h = res_eval$ZT_true,
    pred_h = res_eval$ZT_pred
  )

  auc_all[[eval_id]] <- tibble(
    target_n_cell = target_n_cell,
    actual_n_cell = nrow(res_eval),
    repeat_id = rep_id,
    source = phase_index_success$source[i],
    object_file = phase_index_success$object_file[i],
    res_phase_file = phase_index_success$res_phase_file[i],
    ZT_points = paste(sort(unique(metadata$ZT_sym)), collapse = ","),
    AUC = m_i$AUC,
    MedAE = m_i$MedAE,
    n_cell = m_i$n_cell,
    median_Rbar = median(res_phase$Rbar, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_r_cell = median(res_phase$r_cell, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  cdf_all[[eval_id]] <- tibble(
    target_n_cell = target_n_cell,
    repeat_id = rep_id,
    source = phase_index_success$source[i],
    threshold_h = m_i$threshold_h,
    pct_correct = m_i$pct_correct
  )

  eval_all[[eval_id]] <- res_eval %>%
    mutate(
      abs_err_h = circ_abs_err_h(pred_h = ZT_pred, true_h = ZT_true),
      target_n_cell = target_n_cell,
      actual_n_cell = nrow(res_eval),
      repeat_id = rep_id,
      source = phase_index_success$source[i]
    )

  eval_id <- eval_id + 1

  rm(obj_sim, metadata, res_phase, res_eval, m_i)
  gc()
}

auc_all <- bind_rows(auc_all)
cdf_all <- bind_rows(cdf_all)
eval_all <- bind_rows(eval_all)

write_csv(auc_all, file.path(out_dir, "cell_number_cell_phase_auc_medae_all.csv"))
saveRDS(auc_all, file.path(out_dir, "cell_number_cell_phase_auc_medae_all.rds"))

write_csv(cdf_all, file.path(out_dir, "cell_number_cell_phase_cdf_raw_all.csv"))
saveRDS(cdf_all, file.path(out_dir, "cell_number_cell_phase_cdf_raw_all.rds"))

write_csv(eval_all, file.path(out_dir, "cell_number_cell_phase_eval_cell_all.csv"))
saveRDS(eval_all, file.path(out_dir, "cell_number_cell_phase_eval_cell_all.rds"))

# Step 6. Summarise AUC and MedAE

auc_median <- auc_all %>%
  group_by(target_n_cell) %>%
  summarise(
    actual_n_cell = median(actual_n_cell, na.rm = TRUE),
    AUC = median(AUC, na.rm = TRUE),
    MedAE = median(MedAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_Rbar = median(median_Rbar, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_r_cell = median(median_r_cell, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_repeat = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(target_n_cell))

print(auc_median)

write_csv(auc_median, file.path(out_dir, "cell_number_cell_phase_auc_medae_median.csv"))
saveRDS(auc_median, file.path(out_dir, "cell_number_cell_phase_auc_medae_median.rds"))

representative_runs <- auc_all %>%
  left_join(
    auc_median %>%
      select(target_n_cell, MedAE_median = MedAE),
    by = "target_n_cell"
  ) %>%
  mutate(diff_to_median = abs(MedAE - MedAE_median)) %>%
  group_by(target_n_cell) %>%
  arrange(diff_to_median, repeat_id) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(target_n_cell))

print(representative_runs)

write_csv(
  representative_runs,
  file.path(out_dir, "representative_runs_by_median_MedAE_cell_number.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  representative_runs,
  file.path(out_dir, "representative_runs_by_median_MedAE_cell_number.rds")
)

# Step 7. Build grid CDF curve

threshold_grid <- seq(0, 12, by = 0.05)

cdf_grid_all <- list()
grid_id <- 1

for (i in seq_len(nrow(phase_index_success))) {
  target_n_cell <- phase_index_success$target_n_cell[i]
  rep_id <- phase_index_success$repeat_id[i]

  obj_sim <- readRDS(phase_index_success$object_file[i])

  metadata <- obj_sim@meta.data %>%
    as.data.frame()
  metadata$cell <- rownames(metadata)

  res_phase <- readRDS(phase_index_success$res_phase_file[i])

  res_eval <- res_phase %>%
    mutate(cell = as.character(cell)) %>%
    left_join(
      metadata %>%
        select(cell, ZT_true, theta_true, theta_obs, ZT_sym, celltype, condition, group),
      by = "cell"
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(ZT_true), is.finite(ZT_pred))

  cdf_grid_all[[grid_id]] <- make_grid_cdf(
    true_h = res_eval$ZT_true,
    pred_h = res_eval$ZT_pred,
    threshold_grid = threshold_grid
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      target_n_cell = target_n_cell,
      repeat_id = rep_id,
      source = phase_index_success$source[i]
    ) %>%
    select(target_n_cell, repeat_id, source, threshold_h, pct_correct)

  grid_id <- grid_id + 1

  rm(obj_sim, metadata, res_phase, res_eval)
  gc()
}

cdf_grid_all <- bind_rows(cdf_grid_all)

cdf_median <- cdf_grid_all %>%
  group_by(target_n_cell, threshold_h) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_correct = median(pct_correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(target_n_cell), threshold_h)

write_csv(cdf_grid_all, file.path(out_dir, "cell_number_cell_phase_cdf_grid_all.csv"))
saveRDS(cdf_grid_all, file.path(out_dir, "cell_number_cell_phase_cdf_grid_all.rds"))

write_csv(cdf_median, file.path(out_dir, "cell_number_cell_phase_cdf_median_curve.csv"))
saveRDS(cdf_median, file.path(out_dir, "cell_number_cell_phase_cdf_median_curve.rds"))

# Step 8. Plot CDF curves

cell_number_vec_success <- cell_number_vec[cell_number_vec %in% auc_median$target_n_cell]

legend_labels <- c()

for (target_n_cell in cell_number_vec_success) {
  auc_i <- auc_median %>%
    filter(target_n_cell == !!target_n_cell)

  legend_labels <- c(
    legend_labels,
    paste0(

      sprintf("%.3f", auc_i$AUC),

      sprintf("%.3f", auc_i$MedAE)
    )
  )
}

print(legend_labels)

draw_cdf <- function() {
  par(
    family = "serif",
    mar = c(4, 4, 2.5, 1),
    mgp = c(2.1, 0.55, 0),
    tcl = -0.25,
    lwd = 0.5
  )

  plot(
    NA,
    xlim = c(-0.3, 12.5),
    ylim = c(-2, 102),
    xlab = "Correct to within (hrs)",
    ylab = "% correct",
    main = "Absolute error CDF",
    cex.main = 0.9,
    cex.lab = 0.8,
    cex.axis = 0.75,
    bty = "n"
  )

  box(lwd = 0.5)
  abline(a = 0, b = 100 / 12, col = "lightgray", lwd = 0.7)

  for (target_n_cell in cell_number_vec_success) {
    cdf_i <- cdf_median %>%
      filter(target_n_cell == !!target_n_cell)

    lines(
      cdf_i$threshold_h,
      cdf_i$pct_correct,
      col = cell_number_cols[as.character(target_n_cell)],
      lwd = 1.2
    )
  }

  legend(
    "bottomright",
    legend = c("        AUC, MedAE", legend_labels),
    col = c(NA, cell_number_cols[as.character(cell_number_vec_success)]),
    lwd = c(NA, rep(1.2, length(cell_number_vec_success))),
    bty = "o",
    box.lwd = 0.3,
    cex = 0.52,
    y.intersp = 0.86
  )
}

)
draw_cdf()
dev.off()

draw_cdf()

# Step 9. Plot representative scatter plots with unified plot_phase_scatter style

for (i in seq_len(nrow(representative_runs))) {
  target_n_cell_i <- representative_runs$target_n_cell[i]
  rep_id_i <- representative_runs$repeat_id[i]

  message("Plotting scatter | target_n_cell = ", target_n_cell_i, " | repeat = ", rep_id_i)

  obj_sim <- readRDS(representative_runs$object_file[i])

  metadata <- obj_sim@meta.data %>%
    as.data.frame()
  metadata$cell <- rownames(metadata)

  res_phase <- readRDS(representative_runs$res_phase_file[i])

  scatter_base <- paste0(
    "cell", target_n_cell_i,
    "_rep", rep_id_i,
    "_phase_scatter"
  )

  save_phase_scatter(
    res_phase = res_phase,
    metadata = metadata,
    title_text = paste0(format(target_n_cell_i, big.mark = ","), " cells"),
    point_col = cell_number_cols[as.character(target_n_cell_i)],
    out_pdf = file.path(plot_dir, paste0(scatter_base, ".pdf")),
    out_tiff = file.path(plot_dir, paste0(scatter_base, ".tiff"))
  )

  rm(obj_sim, metadata, res_phase)
  gc()
}
